title: New required configuration
description: The server now requires PAYMENTS_API_KEY, declared in .env.example without a value. A dotenv example cannot say a variable is required, so Crashpad does not flag the blank value itself; the startup check catches the crash, and the new variable is listed as needing a test value. Crashpad never invents one.

expectMissing.config: PAYMENTS_API_KEY is newly declared in .env.example:6 and has no test value
